title: WalletRoundingRecord
description: Shared interchange shape used by every language implementation (Go, C++, Python, Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript) and both SQL schemas. The same shape and the same rule apply to every wallet — there is no owner-specific field.

wallet_id.description: Opaque wallet identifier. Carries no role/owner semantics for rounding purposes.

raw_balance.description: Full-precision raw amount, as a decimal string (never a float, to avoid precision loss).

decimals.description: Target rounding precision, identical for all wallets in a given deployment.

rounded_balance.description: raw_balance rounded to `decimals` places using round-half-up (away from zero), via the shared round_wallet_balance() logic.

rounding_mode.description: Fixed at 'nearest' (round-half-up) for all wallets; present for forward-compatibility only, not for per-account overrides.
